decisions.decision: Figma is the design-system authority. On disagreement Figma wins: flag it, change Figma first, then code.
Figma's variant names win. Real code-only options are added to Figma rather than deleted from code.
A property that carries a value (checked, on/off, dismissible) gets its own Figma property — it is not a Variant.
Prototypes live in app/prototypes/<slug> and never modify the library. Gaps are composed locally from primitives and logged as candidates.
App code uses semantic tokens only. Primitive ramps (--atlas-color-*) are for token definitions, not components or screens.
Keep packages/ui-web. No restructure into src/components — that would be exactly the unrelated refactoring the harness forbids.
lg label uses --atlas-font-size-lg, continuing sm→text-sm, md→text-body. Not specified in Figma; confirm during the Checkbox metadata pass.

A cloned prototype keeps colours that have no semantic token in app/prototypes/<slug>/brand.ts and nowhere else; token-lint and atlas-verify exempt only that file and list it. Shared prototype chrome (_shared/, e.g. PhoneFrame) uses semantic tokens only. No inline token-lint suppressions in app/.

v1.1 adds exactly five web-only components — Avatar, Breadcrumb, Divider, Timeline, DescriptionList — one at a time, each behind a Figma approval gate and a final approval gate. Native parity is logged in candidates.json, not built. Semantic tokens these five need have standing approval and go Figma foundations first, then packages/tokens, then the component.

Avatar follows the ReUI reference (Type Image|Text|Icon × Size × boolean Show status / Show badge icon, status as an instance swap defaulting to success) plus a Shape property circle|squircle. Sizes xs|sm|md|lg|xl = spacing/5|6|8|10|12; the 10px status dot maps to spacing/2. Squircle is a rounded square via avatar-squircle-radius-{size} tokens aliasing existing radii (no Figma-only smoothing). AvatarGroup overlap is the avatar-group-overlap token (-spacing/2). No disabled state; Avatar is presentational. Image alt: informative → meaningful alt, decorative beside a name → alt="", failed image → initials → icon.
